active_construction_reason: Not exposed or not separately instrumented; no reconstruction from elapsed service windows.

attempts.command_failure_boundary: Includes intended rejection/diagnosis and environment/source failures; independent of proof outcome.

checking_windows.boundary: Live development service windows include cold supplier reconstruction, active checks and idle coordination. They do not measure active construction or pure checker CPU. Fresh noninteractive windows are reported separately by exact ID.

coordination_reason: Not exposed or not separately instrumented; no reconstruction from elapsed service windows.
cumulative_reason: Stage and predecessor histories do not expose a complete nonoverlapping active-work measure.
host_usage_boundary: Host process observations exclude Docker engine/checker. Do not report these as prover CPU.
human_boundary: Logged during stage commands; does not convert human review PENDING into approval.
memory_reason: Per-invocation memory cap is exposed; no measured peak supplied by this ledger.
model_tokens_cost_reason: Execution runtime does not expose exact model, token, or billing counters.

module_observations.boundary: Actual development module attempts, including failed and intentional diagnostic modules; no fixture copies. CPU is checker-reported module CPU, not construction, total cold reconstruction, or acceptance.

stage.elapsed_boundary: Inclusive stage window overlaps checking and coordination; it is not active proof-construction CPU.
stage.post_construction_checking_policy: Final source was sealed before the construction deadline; each separately measured checking invocation retains its own 1800-second cap. Elapsed observation beyond the deadline does not extend construction authorization.

supplier_construction_reason: Historical supplier construction was not fully measured; no retrospective invention.
